script_note: Use fast_search.py --provider google-scholar for bounded public discovery without an API key. Enrich selected records with public metadata, then use paper-brief or full evidence.

retrieval_stages.discovery: Find candidates and return title, author, year, citation/version counts, links, and snippet-only text.
retrieval_stages.paper-brief: For selected papers, supplement metadata and abstract, extract section outline, and quote only author-stated contributions.
retrieval_stages.full-audit: Only on explicit request, read the primary PDF or body for methods, results, limitations, and exact claims.

source_requirement: Google Scholar snippets are discovery evidence only. Metadata enrichment, paper-brief, or primary paper evidence is required for claims beyond candidate discovery.
agent_rule: One academic Agent owns Scholar discovery, metadata enrichment, selected-paper brief extraction, and any explicitly requested full evidence stage.
